name: Mold Ether
description: Repair, manipulate, or redirect Aetheric relics. Requires a steady hand and high Schooling.
effect: Repair, recharge, or redirect Aether flow in a relic.

name: Aether Bolt
description: A focused lance of Aetheric force. The runecaster grows warm in the hand.

name: Aether Shield
description: Conjure a translucent barrier of Aether that absorbs incoming force.

name: Aether Lance
description: A heavier strike than Aether Bolt, capable of cracking Aetherstone.
effect: Single-target ranged attack; bonus damage vs Aetherstone constructs.

name: Shape Aetherstone
description: Form, slow, or reshape Aetherstone around you. The core Aethercraft of the True Tartarians.
effect: Move, mold, or harden Aetherstone in arm's reach.

name: Etheric Pulse
description: Send a shockwave of Aetheric force outward. Friend or foe, it knocks them back.
effect: AoE close-range knockback; technology disabled briefly.

name: Temporal Slip
description: Step a half-second sideways through time. To onlookers, you simply weren't there.
effect: Once per encounter, dodge a single incoming attack outright.

name: Summon Mud Arm
description: A heavy arm of Aetherstone rises from the ground at your command.
effect: Conjure a temporary construct limb for grappling, blocking, or smashing.

name: Veil of Ether
description: Wrap yourself in living Aether. You become hard to perceive, harder to harm.
effect: +5 AC and disadvantage against you for 1d6 rounds. Costs 1d6 self-damage.

name: Resonance Cascade
description: Zalmar's last spell. They tell you not to learn it. They are right.
effect: Massive AoE Aether burst. Risk of permanent Corruption gain.
